name: JAMTRACK
author: PhilipsKnobs
tagline: a backing band for the FM-1
description: JAMTRACK turns the FM-1 into a backing band to play over: drums, bass, chords and a synth line follow a chord progression written in Nashville numbers, in any key and time signature. Indie, dream pop, bedroom, funk, folk, rock, blues, hip hop and more; acoustic and vintage drum kits plus one of your own; parts A and B, fills, endings, tap tempo and MIDI clock in, START and STOP from a loop pedal. Jams save, and the companion web app edits them.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments), MPL-2.0.
